Layer.ows:Title: Global land and water coverage
Layer.ows:Abstract: 30 arc second compilation of EMODnet Bathymetry 2018, GEBCO 2019 and various land DEM sources (ASTER, SRTM, EU DEM and viewfinderspanoramas.org) in traditional atlas style colours

Layer.ows:Title: Global land coverage
Layer.ows:Abstract: 30 arc second compilation of various land DEM sources (ASTER, SRTM, EU DEM and viewfinderspanoramas.org)

Layer.ows:Title: Mean depth full coverage with land coverage (DTM release 2016)
Layer.ows:Abstract: Mean depth based on source resolution of 1/8 arc minute (~250 meter). Full coverage ocean and land DTM in traditional atlas style colours.

Layer.ows:Title: Mean depth full coverage with land coverage (DTM release 2018)
Layer.ows:Abstract: Mean depth based on source resolution of 1/16 arc minute (~125 meter). Full coverage ocean and land DTM in traditional atlas style colours.

Layer.ows:Title: Mean depth full coverage with land coverage (DTM release 2020)
Layer.ows:Abstract: Mean depth based on source resolution of 1/16 arc minute (~125 meter). Full coverage ocean and land DTM in traditional atlas style colours.

Layer.ows:Title: Mean depth full coverage with land coverage (DTM release 2022)
Layer.ows:Abstract: Mean depth based on source resolution of 1/16 arc minute (~125 meter).
